description: Stable error code registry shared by the Python WorkerHost and C# client. Codes are part of the v1 wire contract: the UI maps codes to user-visible behavior and must NEVER parse Python tracebacks. The 'retryable' flag encodes design §7 retry policy — queries auto-retry once on worker crash; mutations (pdf save/mutation, dependency install, backend switch, update) never auto-retry. Keep entries in sync with envelope.schema.json#rpc_error/code enum.

codes.message: The request was malformed or referenced an unknown method.
A required runtime dependency is missing; open dependency repair.
The OCR worker is unavailable; retrying may help.
Protocol versions are incompatible; an update is required.
A resource limit (memory, workers, sessions) was reached.
An internal error occurred; diagnostics were logged.
